flavor_text.one_paragraph: The Hellashur are a vigorous merchant oligarchy people, a first-order synthesis of Ellinike and Shamhar [Peer Synthesis / Mercantile]. They prize law, honor, valor, lean toward the military sphere, and field heavy_infantry, light_infantry, marines. Outsiders are met as cosmopolitan; their patrons touch war.
